# Sensory

> > Sensory delivers high-accuracy, low-power on-device AI for voice, sound, and biometric authentication across embedded systems, IoT, and consumer devices.

Sensory specializes in edge AI solutions that run locally on devices without cloud connectivity, enabling privacy-first voice recognition, speaker verification, sound detection, and face biometrics. The platform serves automotive, healthcare, retail, wearables, and enterprise markets with production-ready technologies and the VoiceHub self-service builder.

## Key Topics

- On-Device AI
- Edge Computing
- Wake Word Detection
- Voice Biometrics
- Speaker Verification
- Speech-to-Text
- Sound Detection (SoundID)
- Face Verification
- Privacy-First Processing
- Embedded Systems
- Voice Authentication
- Custom Grammars
- Low-Power AI
- VoiceHub
- Biometric Authentication

## Core Products

- [Sensory | High-Accuracy, Low-Power On-Device AI for Voice, Sound & Biometrics](https://sensory.com): Sensory homepage showcasing on-device AI for voice, sound, and biometrics
- [Smart Wake Word | Flexible, Accurate, On-Device AI](https://sensory.com/product/smart-wake-word): Smart Wake Word product with context-aware, adaptive voice activation
- [Wake Word | Ultra-Low Power On-Device Wake Word Technology](https://sensory.com/product/wake-word): Core wake word detection product for embedded devices and IoT
- [Personalized Wake Word | User-Defined, On-Device Voice Activation](https://sensory.com/product/personalized-wake-word): Custom wake word creation with voice-based security and personalization
- [Secure Wake Word | On-Device Voice Authentication](https://sensory.com/product/secure-wake-word): Wake word with speaker verification for secure device authentication
- [Speech-to-Text | On-Device, Private, Low-Latency Transcription](https://sensory.com/product/speech-to-text): Real-time speech-to-text transcription across Android, iOS, and platforms

## Voice & Sound Intelligence

- [Phrase Spotted Commands | On-Device Voice Command Control](https://sensory.com/product/spotted-commands): Multi-phrase voice command recognition for embedded voice control
- [Micro Language Models & Custom Grammars | On-Device NLU](https://sensory.com/product/micro-language-and-custom-grammar-models): Compact NLU and custom grammars for embedded device understanding
- [SoundID | On-Device Sound Detection & Classification AI](https://sensory.com/product/ai-sound-id): Real-time sound detection and classification for alerts and audio events

## Biometric Authentication

- [Text-Independent Speaker Verification | On-Device Voice Biometrics](https://sensory.com/product/ai-text-independent-speaker-verification): Natural speech speaker verification for voice-based biometric authentication
- [Text-Dependent Speaker Verification | Secure On-Device Voice Authentication](https://sensory.com/product/ai-text-dependent-speaker-verification): Phrase-based speaker verification for secure voice authentication
- [On-Device AI Face Verification | Private, Fast & Secure Biometrics](https://sensory.com/product/ai-face-verification): On-device face verification with anti-spoofing and liveness detection

## Development Platform

- [VoiceHub | Self-Service Wake Word & Command Builder for On-Device AI](https://sensory.com/product/voicehub): Self-service platform for building production-ready wake words and commands

## Industry Solutions

- [On-Device Voice & Sound AI for Automotive](https://sensory.com/solution/automotive): Automotive solution with voice control, sound detection, and biometrics
- [On-Device Voice & Biometric AI for PC, Mobile & Tablet](https://sensory.com/solution/pc-mobile-tablet): Cross-platform solution for voice and biometric AI on consumer devices
- [On-Device Voice & Sound AI for Wearables & Smart Glasses](https://sensory.com/solution/wearables): Ultra-low-power AI for wearables, hearables, and smart glasses
- [On-Device Voice AI for Medical Devices & Healthcare](https://sensory.com/solution/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant voice and biometric AI for medical devices
- [On-Device Voice AI for LLM Voice Agents](https://sensory.com/solution/llm-voice-agents): Voice agent solution integrating STT, NLU, and biometrics with LLMs
